ticks.claim: No zero of zeta lies off the critical line by way of a Nicolas (primorial) counterexample using a prime <= 1,000,000: every primorial's ratio N_k/(phi(N_k) ln ln N_k) stays above e^gamma (closest at p=999,983, ratio = 1.781337 > 1.781072). Nicolas 1983 — a fifth independent tool narrowing the window, by elimination.
